title: RPG Design Guides: Early Game ① Opening

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】序盤① オープニング
blocks.translation: RPG Design Guides: Early Game ① Opening

blocks.source: 物語の構成『起承転結』において、序盤を司る『起』が重要である事は言うまでもない。
blocks.translation: Needless to say, in the kishotenketsu structure of a story, the “ki,” which governs the early stages, is important.

blocks.source: この講座では『起』を『オープニング』と『主人公が旅立つまで』の２種類に分けて説明する。この記事ではあくまで冒頭（オープニング）の見せ方について書いているので、旅立ちについてはほとんど触れていない。
blocks.translation: In this guide, I will explain the “ki” in two parts: the “opening” and “the events leading up to the protagonist’s departure.” This article focuses solely on how to present the beginning (the opening), so it barely touches on the protagonist’s departure.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧのオープニングですべきことは主に……
blocks.translation: The main things an RPG opening should do are…

blocks.source: 世界設定の説明。
blocks.translation: Explain the world setting.

blocks.source: 主人公を始めとした登場人物の説明。
blocks.translation: Introduce the characters, including the protagonist.

blocks.source: ゲームシステムの説明。
blocks.translation: Explain the game systems.

blocks.source: プレイヤーを作品に引き込ませる。
blocks.translation: Draw the player into the game.

blocks.source: といったものが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: These are some of the main points.

blocks.source: これらを踏まえた上で魅力あるオープニングというものを考えていきたい。
blocks.translation: With these points in mind, I would like to consider what makes an appealing opening.

blocks.source: しかし、ただダラダラと世界設定や人物、ゲームシステムを説明したところで、プレイヤーの興味を引くのは難しい。
blocks.translation: However, it is difficult to capture the player’s interest by simply droning on about the world, characters, and game systems.

blocks.source: つまり、説明すると同時に「プレイヤーを作品に引き込ませる」必要もある。面白くなるまでに時間がかかるようでは、それまでに飽きられてしまう可能性が高い。
blocks.translation: In other words, while providing explanations, you must also “draw the player into the game.” If it takes too long for the game to become interesting, there is a high chance that players will lose interest before then.

blocks.source: 有名なところでは、ＤＱ７が「最初の戦闘までに数時間かかる」だなんて非難を受けていた。やはり、物語の早い段階でストーリー的、ゲーム的な面白さをプレイヤーに体験させた方が好ましい。
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest VII, for example, was famously criticized for “taking several hours to reach the first battle.” It is generally preferable to let players experience the story and gameplay’s appeal early in the narrative.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、既存ＲＰＧのオープニングを分類してまとめてみた。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I classified and compiled the openings of existing RPGs.

blocks.source: どんなオープニングを作れば良いのか迷う――という人はぜひとも参考にしてみて欲しい。例に挙げた作品は、必ずしも良い例とは限らないのだが、それもまた逆に参考になるかと思う。
blocks.translation: If you are unsure what kind of opening to create, I hope you will use this as a reference. The examples I have listed are not necessarily good examples, but that can also make them useful references in their own way.

blocks.source: 代表的なオープニングのタイプ（場面編）
blocks.translation: Representative Opening Types (By Scene)

blocks.source: どんな場面から始まるかで分類。
blocks.translation: Classified by the kind of scene in which the game begins.

blocks.source: ストレートに始まる
blocks.translation: Starting Directly

blocks.source: 小細工なし。
blocks.translation: No tricks.

blocks.source: 物語の冒頭から直球でプレイヤーに目的を伝える場面から開始する。容量などの都合で、余り長い会話を挟めなかった昔の作品に多い。
blocks.translation: The game begins with a scene that directly tells the player the objective from the start of the story. This was common in older games, which could not include very long conversations due to limitations such as storage capacity.

blocks.source: とはいえ、現代の作品でもテンポやゲーム性を重視するなら、この型を取るのもありだろう。
blocks.translation: That said, even in modern games, this approach can work if you prioritize pacing and gameplay.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト１～２
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest I–II

blocks.source: 冒頭から王様との会話によって、直球で「魔物の親玉を倒せ」という目的が示される。
blocks.translation: A conversation with the king at the very beginning directly establishes the objective: “Defeat the leader of the monsters.”

blocks.source: その後、城の兵士達との会話からゲームシステムや世界観に関する情報を得ていく。とても簡潔。とても無駄がない。
blocks.translation: Afterward, the player learns about the game systems and world through conversations with the soldiers in the castle. Very concise. No wasted motion.

blocks.source: 呼出を受ける
blocks.translation: Being Summoned

blocks.source: 「王様がお呼びだぞ」というような呼出を受けるところから開始。
blocks.translation: The game begins with the protagonist being summoned with words such as, “The king wishes to see you.”

blocks.source: 呼び出した相手から物語当初の目的を聞くことになるという流れ。会いに行くまでにある程度自由に行動できる場合も多い。その途中で町人から舞台設定に関わる情報を得たり、主要人物に出会ったりする。
blocks.translation: The flow is that the person who summoned you tells you the story’s initial objective. In many cases, you can move around with some freedom before going to meet them. Along the way, you may learn information about the setting from townspeople or encounter important characters.

blocks.source: 『ストレートに始まる』よりも、段階を置くことで情報を分散して伝えられる。伝えなければならない情報が多い場合は、こちらの方が有効。
blocks.translation: Compared with “Starting Directly,” this approach spreads out the information by introducing it in stages. It is more effective when there is a lot of information that must be conveyed.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト３
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest III

blocks.source: 朝、母親に起こされる場面から開始するが、すぐに王様の元でＤＱ１～２と同様の目的が与えられる。
blocks.translation: The game begins with the protagonist being woken by their mother in the morning, but the king soon gives them an objective similar to that in Dragon Quest I–II.

blocks.source: ちなみに、リメイク版だとタイトルデモが存在する。そこでは、主人公の父が旅立って消息を絶つという流れが描かれる。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the remake includes a title demo. It depicts the protagonist’s father setting out on a journey and then vanishing.

blocks.source: 放り出す
blocks.translation: Being Left to Your Own Devices

blocks.source: 目的すら明示せずに放置して、プレイヤーの操作に任せる。
blocks.translation: The game leaves the player on their own without even explicitly stating an objective, leaving everything to their control.

blocks.source: 周りの人物に話しかけるなどしているうちに、目的が見えてくるというのが一般的。
blocks.translation: Typically, the objective gradually becomes clear as the player talks to the people around them.

blocks.source: 移動できる範囲を絞って、誘導してあげると上下のタイプに近くなる。テンポ重視。
blocks.translation: Restricting the area the player can move through and guiding them makes this approach more similar to the two types above. It prioritizes pacing.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー１
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy I

blocks.source: フィールド上に放置された状態でスタート。
blocks.translation: The game starts with the party simply left standing on the field.

blocks.source: ……といってもすぐ側に町と城がある。
blocks.translation: …Though there is a town and a castle right nearby.

blocks.source: 城で王様の話を聞くことで、さらわれた姫を助けるという最初の目的を知る。
blocks.translation: By listening to the king at the castle, the player learns the initial objective: rescue the kidnapped princess.

blocks.source: 一応、ゲーム起動時のテロップでは、主人公達が冒険の末に、そこへたどり着いたことが示されてはいる。
blocks.translation: The opening text shown when the game starts does indicate that the protagonists arrived there after a long adventure.

blocks.source: 順当に説明
blocks.translation: Explaining Things in Order

blocks.source: テロップや会話、映像などで、順を追って現在の舞台や状況を説明する。
blocks.translation: Text, conversations, and visuals explain the current setting and situation step by step.

blocks.source: その世界の中で主人公は「どんな立場なのか」が表現され、なすべきことが判明する。
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s “position” in that world is established, revealing what they must do.

blocks.source: 場面転換を駆使しながら、複数人物の動静を見せることも多い。
blocks.translation: It is also common to use scene changes to show what multiple characters are doing.

blocks.source: ＳＲＰＧ的なやり方だと地図や年表が表示しながら、色々と情勢を解説すると雰囲気が出る。
blocks.translation: For a more SRPG-like approach, displaying maps and timelines while explaining various developments can create the right atmosphere.

blocks.source: 要するに最も普通のオープニングの見せ方。プロの小説にも多い手法で分かりやすい。
blocks.translation: In short, this is the most conventional way to present an opening. It is also common in professional novels and easy to understand.

blocks.source: ただし、あまり長々とやると嫌われやすいので注意。
blocks.translation: However, be careful, as making it too long is likely to turn people off.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー５
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy V

blocks.source: 数々のシーンを切り替えながら、プレイヤーに状況説明を行う。
blocks.translation: The game explains the situation to the player while switching between numerous scenes.

blocks.source: 飛竜に乗ってタイクーン城から風の神殿へ旅立つ王。それを見送る娘のレナ。
blocks.translation: The king sets out from Tycoon Castle for the Wind Shrine on a dragon. His daughter, Lenna, sees him off.

blocks.source: 船上にて、風の異変を感じる海賊ファリス。
blocks.translation: Aboard ship, the pirate Faris senses something strange about the wind.

blocks.source: 同じく、どこかで風の異変を感じる謎の老人ガラフ。
blocks.translation: Elsewhere, the mysterious old man Galuf senses something strange about the wind.

blocks.source: 場面が城に戻って、風の停止に気付くレナ。
blocks.translation: The scene returns to the castle, where Lenna notices that the wind has stopped.

blocks.source: 風の神殿にたどり着いた王。しかし、神殿のクリスタルは砕け散る。
blocks.translation: The king reaches the Wind Shrine. However, the crystal in the shrine shatters.

blocks.source: 旅の途中の主人公。突如落下してきた隕石に驚き、様子を見に行く事に。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is traveling when a meteor suddenly falls. Startled, they decide to go investigate.

blocks.source: ここまで４～５分かかって、ようやく操作が可能に。
blocks.translation: It takes four or five minutes to get this far, and only then can you finally take control.

blocks.source: セリフ自体は非常に簡潔なのだが、ゲーム性重視のＦＦ５にしては、意外と長いオープニングである。
blocks.translation: The dialogue itself is extremely concise, but for FFV, which prioritizes gameplay, it has a surprisingly long opening.

blocks.source: ついでに、その後も……
blocks.translation: And, for that matter, afterward as well…

blocks.source: 隕石の側で、魔物に襲われているレナを助ける。
blocks.translation: Rescue Lenna, who is being attacked by monsters near the meteor.

blocks.source: これまた隕石の側に倒れているガラフを助ける。どうやら記憶喪失らしい。
blocks.translation: Then rescue Galuf, who is also lying unconscious near the meteor. Apparently, he has lost his memory.

blocks.source: ２人は風の神殿に向かうらしい。主人公はそれを見送るが、結局後を追う。
blocks.translation: The two of them are apparently heading to the Wind Shrine. The protagonist sees them off, but eventually follows after them.

blocks.source: またも、魔物に襲われている２人を助ける。３人で風の神殿に向かう事に。
blocks.translation: Once again, rescue the two of them from monsters. The three of them decide to head to the Wind Shrine together.

blocks.source: という具合に中々忙しい。
blocks.translation: So, things are pretty hectic.

blocks.source: ご都合主義もあるとはいえ、これだけのイベントを１０分程度で消化するＦＦ５はある意味凄いと思う。
blocks.translation: Despite the contrivances, I think it is impressive in a way that FFV gets through all these events in about ten minutes.

blocks.source: ヴァルキリープロファイル
blocks.translation: Valkyrie Profile

blocks.source: 長いオープニングの筆頭。『世界観の説明』『主人公の過去と説明』『初期の仲間の説明』を一気にまとめてやってしまう。
blocks.translation: A prime example of a long opening. It explains the setting, the protagonist's past, and the initial companions all at once.

blocks.source: 途中、イベント戦闘を挟みはするものの、まともに操作できるようになるまで１時間近くかかる。
blocks.translation: Although an event battle takes place along the way, it takes nearly an hour before you can properly take control.

blocks.source: 複雑な設定を説明するために、こうなってしまったのだと思うのだが……。
blocks.translation: I suppose it ended up this way because of the need to explain the complicated setting, but…

blocks.source: いきなり見せ場
blocks.translation: Jumping Straight into the Action

blocks.source: 状況説明も程々に、いきなり見せ場に突入する。
blocks.translation: After only a limited explanation of the situation, it jumps straight into a major scene.

blocks.source: 速攻で事件発生、または既に事件の真っ只中。
blocks.translation: An incident occurs immediately, or you are already in the middle of one.

blocks.source: 特にダンジョンや戦闘が絡むことが多い。
blocks.translation: Dungeons and battles are especially common elements in these openings.

blocks.source: 一連のイベントが終わった後に町に戻って落ち着いた後に、ようやく主人公がどのような暮らしをしているのかを説明したりする。
blocks.translation: Only after the series of events is over and you return to town and settle down do they finally explain what kind of life the protagonist leads.

blocks.source: 「何をやるのか？」ではなく「何をやっているのか？」から逆算してストーリーを伝える。
blocks.translation: The story is conveyed in reverse, starting not with “What are you going to do?” but with “What are you doing?”

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズがよくやる手法でもある。
blocks.translation: This is also a technique the Final Fantasy series often uses.

blocks.source: プレイヤーが操作できるようにする場合と、操作はさせずに一方的にイベントを見せる場合の２種類に分かれる。
blocks.translation: There are two types: one lets the player take control, while the other shows the player an event without allowing any control.

blocks.source: 基本的には操作できる場合の方が好まれる。
blocks.translation: Generally speaking, letting the player take control is preferred.

blocks.source: プレイヤーの操作を交えながら、スピーディな状況説明が可能なので、ゲームという媒体を活かせる。
blocks.translation: Because it allows the situation to be explained swiftly while incorporating the player's input, it makes good use of the game medium.

blocks.source: ストーリー的には順を追っていないため、プレイヤーを置いてけぼりにしないようには注意。
blocks.translation: Since the story is not presented in chronological order, care must be taken not to leave the player behind.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー２
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy II

blocks.source: 簡素なテロップで、主人公達が帝国の追手から逃げている途中であることが示される。名前入力画面の直後、何のシーンも挟まずに、いきなりの強制敗北戦闘。
blocks.translation: A simple caption establishes that the protagonists are fleeing from the Empire's pursuers. Immediately after the name-entry screen, there is a sudden scripted battle that the player is forced to lose, without any intervening scene.

blocks.source: そして、反乱軍に救命された主人公達が帝国との戦いに立ち上がる――というのが一連の流れ。
blocks.translation: The overall flow is that the protagonists are rescued by the rebel army and rise up to fight the Empire.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー３
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy III

blocks.source: いきなり落とし穴から、謎の洞窟に落ちる主人公達４人。
blocks.translation: The four protagonists suddenly fall through a pit into a mysterious cave.

blocks.source: その洞窟を探検する中で、発見したクリスタルから世界を救うように言われる。
blocks.translation: While exploring the cave, they are told by a crystal they discover to save the world.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー７
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy VII

blocks.source: ２分程度のムービー（街の外観など）の後、列車から主人公が敵地に飛び降りるところから操作開始。
blocks.translation: After a roughly two-minute cutscene showing things such as the cityscape, control begins as the protagonist jumps from a train into enemy territory.

blocks.source: テロップによる説明はない。
blocks.translation: There is no explanation through captions.

blocks.source: 魔晄炉爆破というミッションを通して、仲間との会話を挟みながら、その目的や世界設定が伝わるようになっている。
blocks.translation: Through the mission to blow up a mako reactor, the game's objective and world setting are conveyed through conversations with the other members of the group.

blocks.source: ＦＦ６も似たようなタイプなのだが、いずれも秀逸な構成だと思う。
blocks.translation: FFVI is a similar type, and I think both games have excellent structure.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー８
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy VIII

blocks.source: 冒頭のムービーで、主人公とライバルの決闘シーンが描かれる。ただし、こちらは操作できないパターン。
blocks.translation: The opening cutscene depicts a duel between the protagonist and their rival. However, this is the type where you cannot take control.

blocks.source: 決闘に敗北、運び込まれた学園の医務室から地味に操作開始。その後の流れは『呼出を受ける』に近く、広い学園内を自由に動き回れる。
blocks.translation: After losing the duel, control begins unceremoniously in the infirmary of the academy where the protagonist has been taken. What follows is similar to “Receiving a Summons,” and you can move freely around the expansive academy.

blocks.source: 日常から始まる
blocks.translation: Beginning with Everyday Life

blocks.source: ごく普通の日常から始まる。等身大の視点から、主人公の立場や世界設定について、徐々に説明をしていく。
blocks.translation: It begins with completely ordinary everyday life. From a relatable perspective, it gradually explains the protagonist's position and the setting.

blocks.source: ちょっとした冒険から徐々に大きな目標に向かうパターンもあれば、急激な破綻を迎えるパターンもある。
blocks.translation: Some follow a pattern of gradually moving from a small adventure toward a major goal, while others undergo a sudden breakdown.

blocks.source: クロノトリガー
blocks.translation: Chrono Trigger

blocks.source: 朝、母親に起こされて祭りに出かける、というように日常の延長から開始する。
blocks.translation: It begins as an extension of everyday life: the protagonist is woken by their mother in the morning and goes to a festival.

blocks.source: 住民との会話から、世界設定が分かるようになっている。
blocks.translation: The setting is revealed through conversations with the townspeople.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト７
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest VII

blocks.source: 主人公と王子キーファが島の遺跡を探検するシーンから開始。
blocks.translation: The game begins with a scene in which the protagonist and Prince Kiefer explore the ruins on an island.

blocks.source: 長いフラグ立てと謎解きに、数時間かけた後で別世界にワープ。直後に最初の戦闘もある。
blocks.translation: After spending several hours setting flags and solving puzzles, the characters warp to another world. The first battle takes place immediately afterward.

blocks.source: 前述した通り、前置きが長すぎて不評を浴びた例。
blocks.translation: As mentioned earlier, this is an example that was poorly received because the setup was too long.

blocks.source: 個人的にはこういう流れもアリなのだが、それにしてもフラグ立てが多すぎたかなあと。
blocks.translation: Personally, I think this kind of progression can work, but even so, there may have been too many flags to set.

blocks.source: 新天地からスタート
blocks.translation: Starting in a New Land

blocks.source: 新しい町や島、あるいは組織にやって来るところから物語が開始。
blocks.translation: The story begins when the protagonist arrives in a new town, island, or organization.

blocks.source: 主人公にとってもプレイヤーにとっても未知の場所なので、自然と説明をしやすいのが長所。
blocks.translation: Since the location is unknown to both the protagonist and the player, it is naturally easy to provide explanations, which is an advantage.

blocks.source: まあ、「久し振りのＸＸＸＸだな」というパターンもあるけれど似たようなものかと。
blocks.translation: There is also the pattern of “It’s been a while since I was in XXXX,” but I suppose it is more or less the same.

blocks.source: ペルソナ３～４
blocks.translation: Persona 3–4

blocks.source: 学園モノらしく新しい学校に転校するところから開始する。
blocks.translation: As befits a school-based story, the game begins with the protagonist transferring to a new school.

blocks.source: 教室で自己紹介、隣の席の人物に話しかけられるといった恒例の展開が続く。
blocks.translation: The usual developments follow, such as introducing oneself in class and being approached by the person sitting nearby.

blocks.source: 代表的なオープニングのタイプ（時系列編）
blocks.translation: Representative Opening Types (Chronological Order)

blocks.source: 冒頭シーンの時系列で分類。
blocks.translation: Classified according to the chronology of the opening scenes.

blocks.source: 過去の出来事
blocks.translation: Events from the Past

blocks.source: 物語開始時点よりも、過去の出来事を冒頭に持ってくる。これも定番のパターン。
blocks.translation: Events from the past, rather than from the point when the story begins, are brought to the opening. This is also a standard pattern.

blocks.source: なお、少し過去の出来事を持ってくるだけなら『順当に説明』と大差ない。
blocks.translation: That said, simply showing events from a little earlier is not much different from “explaining things in due course.”

blocks.source: 例としては……
blocks.translation: Examples include…

blocks.source: 何百年前の伝説の戦い
blocks.translation: A legendary battle from hundreds of years ago

blocks.source: 主人公の両親など、数十年前の出来事
blocks.translation: Events from several decades ago, such as those involving the protagonist’s parents

blocks.source: 主人公の出生にまつわるシーン
blocks.translation: A scene related to the protagonist’s birth

blocks.source: 主人公自身の過去
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s own past

blocks.source: オープニングが終わった後は現代の主人公に操作が移る。
blocks.translation: After the opening ends, control shifts to the protagonist in the present day.

blocks.source: 主人公に関わるシーンが扱われることが多いのは、ストーリーに連続性がある方が、プレイヤーに理解しやすいためだろう。
blocks.translation: Scenes involving the protagonist are often used because a continuous story is easier for the player to understand.

blocks.source: これも分かりやすいが、やはりテンポが悪くなりやすいのが欠点か。
blocks.translation: This is also easy to understand, but its drawback is that it tends to make the pacing suffer.

blocks.source: そのためか、過去の出来事をあえて冒頭には持ってこず、少し後から伝えるＤＱ８のような作品もある。
blocks.translation: Perhaps for that reason, some games, such as DQ8, deliberately do not present past events at the beginning and reveal them a little later.

blocks.source: ブレスオブファイア２
blocks.translation: Breath of Fire II

blocks.source: 主人公の幼少時代を操作しながら体験する。時間としては10分程度。
blocks.translation: You experience the protagonist’s childhood while controlling him. It takes about ten minutes.

blocks.source: 住んでいた町の様子が一変、後の親友ボッシュと出会い、共に町を離れる経緯が描かれる。
blocks.translation: The town where he lives suddenly changes completely, he meets Bosch, who will later become his best friend, and the events leading to their leaving town together are depicted.

blocks.source: 一気に年数が飛んで、現代の主人公に移る。
blocks.translation: The story then jumps forward several years at once and shifts to the protagonist in the present day.

blocks.source: ちなみに、幼少時代の伏線は相当終盤まで引っ張る。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the foreshadowing from his childhood is carried through until quite near the end.

blocks.source: エストポリス伝記
blocks.translation: Estpolis Biography

blocks.source: 主人公の祖先でもある１００年前の英雄達の戦いから物語が始まる。
blocks.translation: The story begins with a battle fought by heroes from 100 years ago, who are also ancestors of the protagonist.

blocks.source: プレイヤーが自分で操作して、ダンジョン探索と戦闘を行うため『いきなり見せ場』とも分類できる。
blocks.translation: Because the player directly controls the characters through dungeon exploration and battles, it can also be classified as “jumping straight into the action.”

blocks.source: ただし、ここで稼いだアイテムや経験値は、本編開始後には何の意味もなさないのが玉に瑕。
blocks.translation: However, it is unfortunate that the items and experience earned here become completely meaningless once the main story begins.

blocks.source: 未来の出来事
blocks.translation: Events from the Future

blocks.source: 逆にゲーム開始時点よりも、未来の出来事をオープニングに持ってくる。
blocks.translation: Conversely, events from the future, rather than from the point when the game begins, are brought into the opening.

blocks.source: 時系列を逆転させるので、プレイヤーを混乱させないように注意。
blocks.translation: Since the chronology is reversed, take care not to confuse the player.

blocks.source: 未来を見せるという事は作者自らネタバレをしてしまうということ。
blocks.translation: Showing the future means that the creator is spoiling the story themselves.

blocks.source: 既に判明した結果に対して、意外性のない過程を持ってくるなんて構成ならやる意味はない。作中の見せ場や印象深いシーンを使った上で、「どうしてこうなった！？」というようにプレイヤーへ過程の興味を引くようにしたい。
blocks.translation: There is no point in structuring the story so that the process leading to an already revealed result is unsurprising. Instead, use a dramatic or memorable scene from the story to make the player curious about how things came to be, asking, “How did this happen?!”

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー１０
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy X

blocks.source: ネタバレにならない程度に物語の転換点より、少し前を見せている例。
blocks.translation: This is an example of showing a point shortly before the story’s turning point without giving away spoilers.

blocks.source: 物語の目的地ザナルカンドの入口に到着した時点から開始。名曲『ザナルカンドにて』がとても印象深い。
blocks.translation: The story begins when the characters arrive at the entrance to Zanarkand, their destination. The famous song “To Zanarkand” is especially memorable.

blocks.source: そこから、回想という形でゲーム開始時点までさかのぼって、ゲーム後半にようやく冒頭へ繋がる。
blocks.translation: From there, the story goes back in the form of a flashback to the point when the game begins, finally connecting to the opening in the latter half of the game.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジータクティクス
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy Tactics

blocks.source: 全４章構成の物語だが、オープニングとなるのは２章冒頭。
blocks.translation: Although the story consists of four chapters, its opening takes place at the beginning of Chapter 2.

blocks.source: 操作できる戦闘（といっても、ほとんど自動）の後で、主人公の親友ディリータが王女を誘拐するシーンとなる。
blocks.translation: After a controllable battle (though it is almost entirely automatic), there is a scene in which the protagonist’s best friend, Delita, kidnaps the princess.

blocks.source: この時点ではチンプンカンプンなのだが、さかのぼって１章を経ることで、話が繋がるという構成。
blocks.translation: It makes no sense at this point, but the story comes together after going back through Chapter 1.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: やはり、ＲＰＧに限らずゲームのオープニングたるもの、「まずは操作をさせなくては始まらない」というのが僕の意見。
blocks.translation: Ultimately, whether or not it is an RPG, my opinion is that a game opening should begin with the principle that “you have to let the player take control first.”

blocks.source: すぐにダンジョン探索や戦闘を体験させられる『いきなり見せ場』はその点で優れている。
blocks.translation: In that respect, “jumping straight into the action,” allowing players to experience dungeon exploration or battles right away, is an excellent approach.

blocks.source: 『順当に説明』や『過去の出来事』などを長々とやるのは嫌われやすいのだが、ストーリー面でプレイヤーを引き込む自信があるならば、それも良いかもしれない。ともかく『長い』『つまらない』『意味不明』というのは避けたい。
blocks.translation: Long, drawn-out sections of “straightforward exposition” or “past events” tend to be unpopular, but if you are confident in your ability to draw players in through the story, they might work. In any case, you want to avoid things being “long,” “boring,” or “incomprehensible.”

blocks.source: というところで『序盤を面白くするテクニック』を考えてみたので、これで締めくくりとしたい。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I have come up with some “techniques for making the early game interesting,” so I would like to conclude with them.

blocks.source: 序盤を面白くするテクニック
blocks.translation: Techniques for Making the Early Game Interesting

blocks.source: 開発終盤に手直ししよう
blocks.translation: Polish It Up Toward the End of Development

blocks.source: 物語を進行順序通りに作る制作者は多くいると思う。
blocks.translation: I imagine many creators make their stories in chronological order.

blocks.source: その際、制作に慣れない段階で作ったがために、中盤や後半に比較して序盤のクオリティが低いということがあり得る。
blocks.translation: When they do, the quality of the early game may end up lower than that of the middle or latter half because it was created before they had much experience with development.

blocks.source: アピールすべき序盤が相対的に手薄になるわけだが、これはかなりもったいない。
blocks.translation: This means that the early game, which should be making the strongest impression, is relatively neglected—and that is a real waste.

blocks.source: できるならば、オープニングを始めとした序盤のイベントは、作り直せとは言わないまでも、開発終盤に手直しをしてクオリティアップを図りたい。ついでに後半の展開に対して、後付で伏線を張ったりするのも良い。
blocks.translation: If possible, you should polish up the events in the early game, including the opening, toward the end of development, even if you do not go so far as to remake them. It can also be a good idea to add foreshadowing retroactively for developments in the latter half.

blocks.source: 最初のダンジョンに凝ってみる
blocks.translation: Put Some Thought Into the First Dungeon

blocks.source: 最初のダンジョンと言われると、洞窟や森といった地味なものとなりやすい。
blocks.translation: When you think of a first dungeon, it tends to be something plain, such as a cave or forest.

blocks.source: しかし、強くアピールすべき最初のダンジョンが地味なのはもったいない。可能ならば、「曰くありげな遺跡や神殿」「禍々しい大ボスのアジト」「風光明媚な外のダンジョン」などを持ってきてみよう。
blocks.translation: However, it is a waste for the first dungeon—the one that should make a strong impression—to be plain. If possible, try using something like “a mysterious ruin or temple with a story behind it,” “a sinister stronghold belonging to a major boss,” or “a scenic outdoor dungeon.”

blocks.source: 構成上の都合、いきなり大ボスのアジトをぶつけたりするのは難しいかもしれない。それでも、少しでも良いダンジョンとなるように出来る範囲で力を入れてみよう。
blocks.translation: Depending on the structure of the game, it may be difficult to throw the player straight into a major boss’s stronghold. Even so, put as much effort into it as you can to make the dungeon as good as possible.

blocks.source: 例えば、洞窟にしても水晶の洞窟にして神秘的な雰囲気を出してみるとか。
blocks.translation: For example, even if you use a cave, you could make it a crystal cave to create a mystical atmosphere.

blocks.source: 同じく物語を進行通りに作っていた場合、最初のダンジョンはパッとしないものになりがち。最初のダンジョンは短めなのがほとんどだし、開発終盤に蓄積した技術力で強化しておこう。
blocks.translation: Likewise, when a story is created in chronological order, the first dungeon tends to be rather unimpressive. The first dungeon is usually short, so strengthen it with the skills and techniques you have accumulated by the end of development.

lines.translation: [[LINK_1]]>Back to the RPG Design Guides Table of Contents[[/LINK_1]]

texts.物語の構成『起承転結』において、序盤を司る『起』が重要である事は言うまでもない。: Needless to say, in the kishotenketsu structure of a story, the “ki,” which governs the early stages, is important.
texts.この講座では『起』を『オープニング』と『主人公が旅立つまで』の２種類に分けて説明: In this guide, I will explain the “ki” in two parts: the “opening” and “the events leading up to the protagonist’s departure.” This article focuses solely on how to present the beginning (the opening), so it barely touches on the protagonist’s departure.
texts.ＲＰＧのオープニングですべきことは主に……: The main things an RPG opening should do are…
texts.主人公を始めとした登場人物の説明。: Introduce the characters, including the protagonist.
texts.プレイヤーを作品に引き込ませる。: Draw the player into the game.
texts.といったものが挙げられる。: These are some of the main points.
texts.これらを踏まえた上で魅力あるオープニングというものを考えていきたい。: With these points in mind, I would like to consider what makes an appealing opening.
texts.しかし、ただダラダラと世界設定や人物、ゲームシステムを説明したところで、プレイヤ: However, it is difficult to capture the player’s interest by simply droning on about the world, characters, and game systems.
texts.つまり、説明すると同時に「プレイヤーを作品に引き込ませる」必要もある。面白くなる: In other words, while providing explanations, you must also “draw the player into the game.” If it takes too long for the game to become interesting, there is a high chance that players will lose interest before then.
texts.有名なところでは、ＤＱ７が「最初の戦闘までに数時間かかる」だなんて非難を受けてい: Dragon Quest VII, for example, was famously criticized for “taking several hours to reach the first battle.” It is generally preferable to let players experience the story and gameplay’s appeal early in the narrative.
texts.そんなわけで、既存ＲＰＧのオープニングを分類してまとめてみた。: With that in mind, I classified and compiled the openings of existing RPGs.
texts.どんなオープニングを作れば良いのか迷う――という人はぜひとも参考にしてみて欲しい: If you are unsure what kind of opening to create, I hope you will use this as a reference. The examples I have listed are not necessarily good examples, but that can also make them useful references in their own way.
texts.どんな場面から始まるかで分類。: Classified by the kind of scene in which the game begins.
texts.物語の冒頭から直球でプレイヤーに目的を伝える場面から開始する。容量などの都合で、: The game begins with a scene that directly tells the player the objective from the start of the story. This was common in older games, which could not include very long conversations due to limitations such as storage capacity.
texts.とはいえ、現代の作品でもテンポやゲーム性を重視するなら、この型を取るのもありだろ: That said, even in modern games, this approach can work if you prioritize pacing and gameplay.
texts.冒頭から王様との会話によって、直球で「魔物の親玉を倒せ」という目的が示される。: A conversation with the king at the very beginning directly establishes the objective: “Defeat the leader of the monsters.”
texts.その後、城の兵士達との会話からゲームシステムや世界観に関する情報を得ていく。とて: Afterward, the player learns about the game systems and world through conversations with the soldiers in the castle. Very concise. No wasted motion.
texts.「王様がお呼びだぞ」というような呼出を受けるところから開始。: The game begins with the protagonist being summoned with words such as, “The king wishes to see you.”
texts.呼び出した相手から物語当初の目的を聞くことになるという流れ。会いに行くまでにある: The flow is that the person who summoned you tells you the story’s initial objective. In many cases, you can move around with some freedom before going to meet them. Along the way, you may learn information about the setting from townspeople or encounter important characters.
texts.『ストレートに始まる』よりも、段階を置くことで情報を分散して伝えられる。伝えなけ: Compared with “Starting Directly,” this approach spreads out the information by introducing it in stages. It is more effective when there is a lot of information that must be conveyed.
texts.朝、母親に起こされる場面から開始するが、すぐに王様の元でＤＱ１～２と同様の目的が: The game begins with the protagonist being woken by their mother in the morning, but the king soon gives them an objective similar to that in Dragon Quest I–II.
texts.ちなみに、リメイク版だとタイトルデモが存在する。そこでは、主人公の父が旅立って消: Incidentally, the remake includes a title demo. It depicts the protagonist’s father setting out on a journey and then vanishing.
texts.放り出す: Being Left to Your Own Devices
texts.目的すら明示せずに放置して、プレイヤーの操作に任せる。: The game leaves the player on their own without even explicitly stating an objective, leaving everything to their control.
texts.周りの人物に話しかけるなどしているうちに、目的が見えてくるというのが一般的。: Typically, the objective gradually becomes clear as the player talks to the people around them.
texts.移動できる範囲を絞って、誘導してあげると上下のタイプに近くなる。テンポ重視。: Restricting the area the player can move through and guiding them makes this approach more similar to the two types above. It prioritizes pacing.
texts.フィールド上に放置された状態でスタート。: The game starts with the party simply left standing on the field.
texts.……といってもすぐ側に町と城がある。: …Though there is a town and a castle right nearby.
texts.城で王様の話を聞くことで、さらわれた姫を助けるという最初の目的を知る。: By listening to the king at the castle, the player learns the initial objective: rescue the kidnapped princess.
texts.一応、ゲーム起動時のテロップでは、主人公達が冒険の末に、そこへたどり着いたことが: The opening text shown when the game starts does indicate that the protagonists arrived there after a long adventure.
texts.テロップや会話、映像などで、順を追って現在の舞台や状況を説明する。: Text, conversations, and visuals explain the current setting and situation step by step.
texts.その世界の中で主人公は「どんな立場なのか」が表現され、なすべきことが判明する。: The protagonist’s “position” in that world is established, revealing what they must do.
texts.場面転換を駆使しながら、複数人物の動静を見せることも多い。: It is also common to use scene changes to show what multiple characters are doing.
texts.ＳＲＰＧ的なやり方だと地図や年表が表示しながら、色々と情勢を解説すると雰囲気が出: For a more SRPG-like approach, displaying maps and timelines while explaining various developments can create the right atmosphere.
texts.要するに最も普通のオープニングの見せ方。プロの小説にも多い手法で分かりやすい。: In short, this is the most conventional way to present an opening. It is also common in professional novels and easy to understand.
texts.ただし、あまり長々とやると嫌われやすいので注意。: However, be careful, as making it too long is likely to turn people off.
texts.数々のシーンを切り替えながら、プレイヤーに状況説明を行う。: The game explains the situation to the player while switching between numerous scenes.
texts.飛竜に乗ってタイクーン城から風の神殿へ旅立つ王。それを見送る娘のレナ。: The king sets out from Tycoon Castle for the Wind Shrine on a dragon. His daughter, Lenna, sees him off.
texts.船上にて、風の異変を感じる海賊ファリス。: Aboard ship, the pirate Faris senses something strange about the wind.
texts.同じく、どこかで風の異変を感じる謎の老人ガラフ。: Elsewhere, the mysterious old man Galuf senses something strange about the wind.
texts.場面が城に戻って、風の停止に気付くレナ。: The scene returns to the castle, where Lenna notices that the wind has stopped.
texts.風の神殿にたどり着いた王。しかし、神殿のクリスタルは砕け散る。: The king reaches the Wind Shrine. However, the crystal in the shrine shatters.
texts.旅の途中の主人公。突如落下してきた隕石に驚き、様子を見に行く事に。: The protagonist is traveling when a meteor suddenly falls. Startled, they decide to go investigate.
texts.ここまで４～５分かかって、ようやく操作が可能に。: It takes four or five minutes to get this far, and only then can you finally take control.
texts.セリフ自体は非常に簡潔なのだが、ゲーム性重視のＦＦ５にしては、意外と長いオープニ: The dialogue itself is extremely concise, but for FFV, which prioritizes gameplay, it has a surprisingly long opening.
texts.ついでに、その後も……: And, for that matter, afterward as well…
texts.隕石の側で、魔物に襲われているレナを助ける。: Rescue Lenna, who is being attacked by monsters near the meteor.
texts.これまた隕石の側に倒れているガラフを助ける。どうやら記憶喪失らしい。: Then rescue Galuf, who is also lying unconscious near the meteor. Apparently, he has lost his memory.
texts.２人は風の神殿に向かうらしい。主人公はそれを見送るが、結局後を追う。: The two of them are apparently heading to the Wind Shrine. The protagonist sees them off, but eventually follows after them.
texts.またも、魔物に襲われている２人を助ける。３人で風の神殿に向かう事に。: Once again, rescue the two of them from monsters. The three of them decide to head to the Wind Shrine together.
texts.ご都合主義もあるとはいえ、これだけのイベントを１０分程度で消化するＦＦ５はある意: Despite the contrivances, I think it is impressive in a way that FFV gets through all these events in about ten minutes.
texts.長いオープニングの筆頭。『世界観の説明』『主人公の過去と説明』『初期の仲間の説明: A prime example of a long opening. It explains the setting, the protagonist's past, and the initial companions all at once.
texts.途中、イベント戦闘を挟みはするものの、まともに操作できるようになるまで１時間近く: Although an event battle takes place along the way, it takes nearly an hour before you can properly take control.
texts.複雑な設定を説明するために、こうなってしまったのだと思うのだが……。: I suppose it ended up this way because of the need to explain the complicated setting, but…
texts.状況説明も程々に、いきなり見せ場に突入する。: After only a limited explanation of the situation, it jumps straight into a major scene.
texts.速攻で事件発生、または既に事件の真っ只中。: An incident occurs immediately, or you are already in the middle of one.
texts.特にダンジョンや戦闘が絡むことが多い。: Dungeons and battles are especially common elements in these openings.
texts.一連のイベントが終わった後に町に戻って落ち着いた後に、ようやく主人公がどのような: Only after the series of events is over and you return to town and settle down do they finally explain what kind of life the protagonist leads.
texts.「何をやるのか？」ではなく「何をやっているのか？」から逆算してストーリーを伝える: The story is conveyed in reverse, starting not with “What are you going to do?” but with “What are you doing?”
texts.ＦＦシリーズがよくやる手法でもある。: This is also a technique the Final Fantasy series often uses.
texts.プレイヤーが操作できるようにする場合と、操作はさせずに一方的にイベントを見せる場: There are two types: one lets the player take control, while the other shows the player an event without allowing any control.
texts.基本的には操作できる場合の方が好まれる。: Generally speaking, letting the player take control is preferred.
texts.プレイヤーの操作を交えながら、スピーディな状況説明が可能なので、ゲームという媒体: Because it allows the situation to be explained swiftly while incorporating the player's input, it makes good use of the game medium.
texts.ストーリー的には順を追っていないため、プレイヤーを置いてけぼりにしないようには注: Since the story is not presented in chronological order, care must be taken not to leave the player behind.
texts.簡素なテロップで、主人公達が帝国の追手から逃げている途中であることが示される。名: A simple caption establishes that the protagonists are fleeing from the Empire's pursuers. Immediately after the name-entry screen, there is a sudden scripted battle that the player is forced to lose, without any intervening scene.
texts.そして、反乱軍に救命された主人公達が帝国との戦いに立ち上がる――というのが一連の: The overall flow is that the protagonists are rescued by the rebel army and rise up to fight the Empire.
texts.いきなり落とし穴から、謎の洞窟に落ちる主人公達４人。: The four protagonists suddenly fall through a pit into a mysterious cave.
texts.その洞窟を探検する中で、発見したクリスタルから世界を救うように言われる。: While exploring the cave, they are told by a crystal they discover to save the world.
texts.２分程度のムービー（街の外観など）の後、列車から主人公が敵地に飛び降りるところか: After a roughly two-minute cutscene showing things such as the cityscape, control begins as the protagonist jumps from a train into enemy territory.
texts.テロップによる説明はない。: There is no explanation through captions.
texts.魔晄炉爆破というミッションを通して、仲間との会話を挟みながら、その目的や世界設定: Through the mission to blow up a mako reactor, the game's objective and world setting are conveyed through conversations with the other members of the group.
texts.ＦＦ６も似たようなタイプなのだが、いずれも秀逸な構成だと思う。: FFVI is a similar type, and I think both games have excellent structure.
texts.冒頭のムービーで、主人公とライバルの決闘シーンが描かれる。ただし、こちらは操作で: The opening cutscene depicts a duel between the protagonist and their rival. However, this is the type where you cannot take control.
texts.決闘に敗北、運び込まれた学園の医務室から地味に操作開始。その後の流れは『呼出を受: After losing the duel, control begins unceremoniously in the infirmary of the academy where the protagonist has been taken. What follows is similar to “Receiving a Summons,” and you can move freely around the expansive academy.
texts.ごく普通の日常から始まる。等身大の視点から、主人公の立場や世界設定について、徐々: It begins with completely ordinary everyday life. From a relatable perspective, it gradually explains the protagonist's position and the setting.
texts.ちょっとした冒険から徐々に大きな目標に向かうパターンもあれば、急激な破綻を迎える: Some follow a pattern of gradually moving from a small adventure toward a major goal, while others undergo a sudden breakdown.
texts.朝、母親に起こされて祭りに出かける、というように日常の延長から開始する。: It begins as an extension of everyday life: the protagonist is woken by their mother in the morning and goes to a festival.
texts.住民との会話から、世界設定が分かるようになっている。: The setting is revealed through conversations with the townspeople.
texts.主人公と王子キーファが島の遺跡を探検するシーンから開始。: The game begins with a scene in which the protagonist and Prince Kiefer explore the ruins on an island.
texts.長いフラグ立てと謎解きに、数時間かけた後で別世界にワープ。直後に最初の戦闘もある: After spending several hours setting flags and solving puzzles, the characters warp to another world. The first battle takes place immediately afterward.
texts.前述した通り、前置きが長すぎて不評を浴びた例。: As mentioned earlier, this is an example that was poorly received because the setup was too long.
texts.個人的にはこういう流れもアリなのだが、それにしてもフラグ立てが多すぎたかなあと。: Personally, I think this kind of progression can work, but even so, there may have been too many flags to set.
texts.新しい町や島、あるいは組織にやって来るところから物語が開始。: The story begins when the protagonist arrives in a new town, island, or organization.
texts.主人公にとってもプレイヤーにとっても未知の場所なので、自然と説明をしやすいのが長: Since the location is unknown to both the protagonist and the player, it is naturally easy to provide explanations, which is an advantage.
texts.まあ、「久し振りのＸＸＸＸだな」というパターンもあるけれど似たようなものかと。: There is also the pattern of “It’s been a while since I was in XXXX,” but I suppose it is more or less the same.
texts.学園モノらしく新しい学校に転校するところから開始する。: As befits a school-based story, the game begins with the protagonist transferring to a new school.
texts.教室で自己紹介、隣の席の人物に話しかけられるといった恒例の展開が続く。: The usual developments follow, such as introducing oneself in class and being approached by the person sitting nearby.
texts.冒頭シーンの時系列で分類。: Classified according to the chronology of the opening scenes.
texts.物語開始時点よりも、過去の出来事を冒頭に持ってくる。これも定番のパターン。: Events from the past, rather than from the point when the story begins, are brought to the opening. This is also a standard pattern.
texts.なお、少し過去の出来事を持ってくるだけなら『順当に説明』と大差ない。: That said, simply showing events from a little earlier is not much different from “explaining things in due course.”
texts.何百年前の伝説の戦い: A legendary battle from hundreds of years ago
texts.主人公の両親など、数十年前の出来事: Events from several decades ago, such as those involving the protagonist’s parents
texts.主人公の出生にまつわるシーン: A scene related to the protagonist’s birth
texts.オープニングが終わった後は現代の主人公に操作が移る。: After the opening ends, control shifts to the protagonist in the present day.
texts.主人公に関わるシーンが扱われることが多いのは、ストーリーに連続性がある方が、プレ: Scenes involving the protagonist are often used because a continuous story is easier for the player to understand.
texts.これも分かりやすいが、やはりテンポが悪くなりやすいのが欠点か。: This is also easy to understand, but its drawback is that it tends to make the pacing suffer.
texts.そのためか、過去の出来事をあえて冒頭には持ってこず、少し後から伝えるＤＱ８のよう: Perhaps for that reason, some games, such as DQ8, deliberately do not present past events at the beginning and reveal them a little later.
texts.主人公の幼少時代を操作しながら体験する。時間としては10分程度。: You experience the protagonist’s childhood while controlling him. It takes about ten minutes.
texts.住んでいた町の様子が一変、後の親友ボッシュと出会い、共に町を離れる経緯が描かれる: The town where he lives suddenly changes completely, he meets Bosch, who will later become his best friend, and the events leading to their leaving town together are depicted.
texts.一気に年数が飛んで、現代の主人公に移る。: The story then jumps forward several years at once and shifts to the protagonist in the present day.
texts.ちなみに、幼少時代の伏線は相当終盤まで引っ張る。: Incidentally, the foreshadowing from his childhood is carried through until quite near the end.
texts.主人公の祖先でもある１００年前の英雄達の戦いから物語が始まる。: The story begins with a battle fought by heroes from 100 years ago, who are also ancestors of the protagonist.
texts.プレイヤーが自分で操作して、ダンジョン探索と戦闘を行うため『いきなり見せ場』とも: Because the player directly controls the characters through dungeon exploration and battles, it can also be classified as “jumping straight into the action.”
texts.ただし、ここで稼いだアイテムや経験値は、本編開始後には何の意味もなさないのが玉に: However, it is unfortunate that the items and experience earned here become completely meaningless once the main story begins.
texts.逆にゲーム開始時点よりも、未来の出来事をオープニングに持ってくる。: Conversely, events from the future, rather than from the point when the game begins, are brought into the opening.
texts.時系列を逆転させるので、プレイヤーを混乱させないように注意。: Since the chronology is reversed, take care not to confuse the player.
texts.未来を見せるという事は作者自らネタバレをしてしまうということ。: Showing the future means that the creator is spoiling the story themselves.
texts.既に判明した結果に対して、意外性のない過程を持ってくるなんて構成ならやる意味はな: There is no point in structuring the story so that the process leading to an already revealed result is unsurprising. Instead, use a dramatic or memorable scene from the story to make the player curious about how things came to be, asking, “How did this happen?!”
texts.ネタバレにならない程度に物語の転換点より、少し前を見せている例。: This is an example of showing a point shortly before the story’s turning point without giving away spoilers.
texts.物語の目的地ザナルカンドの入口に到着した時点から開始。名曲『ザナルカンドにて』が: The story begins when the characters arrive at the entrance to Zanarkand, their destination. The famous song “To Zanarkand” is especially memorable.
texts.そこから、回想という形でゲーム開始時点までさかのぼって、ゲーム後半にようやく冒頭: From there, the story goes back in the form of a flashback to the point when the game begins, finally connecting to the opening in the latter half of the game.
texts.全４章構成の物語だが、オープニングとなるのは２章冒頭。: Although the story consists of four chapters, its opening takes place at the beginning of Chapter 2.
texts.操作できる戦闘（といっても、ほとんど自動）の後で、主人公の親友ディリータが王女を: After a controllable battle (though it is almost entirely automatic), there is a scene in which the protagonist’s best friend, Delita, kidnaps the princess.
texts.この時点ではチンプンカンプンなのだが、さかのぼって１章を経ることで、話が繋がると: It makes no sense at this point, but the story comes together after going back through Chapter 1.
texts.やはり、ＲＰＧに限らずゲームのオープニングたるもの、「まずは操作をさせなくては始: Ultimately, whether or not it is an RPG, my opinion is that a game opening should begin with the principle that “you have to let the player take control first.”
texts.すぐにダンジョン探索や戦闘を体験させられる『いきなり見せ場』はその点で優れている: In that respect, “jumping straight into the action,” allowing players to experience dungeon exploration or battles right away, is an excellent approach.
texts.『順当に説明』や『過去の出来事』などを長々とやるのは嫌われやすいのだが、ストーリ: Long, drawn-out sections of “straightforward exposition” or “past events” tend to be unpopular, but if you are confident in your ability to draw players in through the story, they might work. In any case, you want to avoid things being “long,” “boring,” or “incomprehensible.”
texts.というところで『序盤を面白くするテクニック』を考えてみたので、これで締めくくりと: With that in mind, I have come up with some “techniques for making the early game interesting,” so I would like to conclude with them.
texts.序盤を面白くするテクニック: Techniques for Making the Early Game Interesting
texts.開発終盤に手直ししよう: Polish It Up Toward the End of Development
texts.物語を進行順序通りに作る制作者は多くいると思う。: I imagine many creators make their stories in chronological order.
texts.その際、制作に慣れない段階で作ったがために、中盤や後半に比較して序盤のクオリティ: When they do, the quality of the early game may end up lower than that of the middle or latter half because it was created before they had much experience with development.
texts.アピールすべき序盤が相対的に手薄になるわけだが、これはかなりもったいない。: This means that the early game, which should be making the strongest impression, is relatively neglected—and that is a real waste.
texts.できるならば、オープニングを始めとした序盤のイベントは、作り直せとは言わないまで: If possible, you should polish up the events in the early game, including the opening, toward the end of development, even if you do not go so far as to remake them. It can also be a good idea to add foreshadowing retroactively for developments in the latter half.
texts.最初のダンジョンに凝ってみる: Put Some Thought Into the First Dungeon
texts.最初のダンジョンと言われると、洞窟や森といった地味なものとなりやすい。: When you think of a first dungeon, it tends to be something plain, such as a cave or forest.
texts.しかし、強くアピールすべき最初のダンジョンが地味なのはもったいない。可能ならば、: However, it is a waste for the first dungeon—the one that should make a strong impression—to be plain. If possible, try using something like “a mysterious ruin or temple with a story behind it,” “a sinister stronghold belonging to a major boss,” or “a scenic outdoor dungeon.”
texts.構成上の都合、いきなり大ボスのアジトをぶつけたりするのは難しいかもしれない。それ: Depending on the structure of the game, it may be difficult to throw the player straight into a major boss’s stronghold. Even so, put as much effort into it as you can to make the dungeon as good as possible.
texts.例えば、洞窟にしても水晶の洞窟にして神秘的な雰囲気を出してみるとか。: For example, even if you use a cave, you could make it a crystal cave to create a mystical atmosphere.
texts.同じく物語を進行通りに作っていた場合、最初のダンジョンはパッとしないものになりが: Likewise, when a story is created in chronological order, the first dungeon tends to be rather unimpressive. The first dungeon is usually short, so strengthen it with the skills and techniques you have accumulated by the end of development.
